modules.module_title: Requirement of Biomass as feedstock in a 2G Ethanol plant in adequate quantity and quality

pcs.pc_description: Understand different type of available Biomass that can be used and type of logistics involved and requirements of baling operation for storage and transportation.

Understand how Biomass is to be weighed and accounted for while receiving at plant and prepared in the process as a feedstock (size reduction, impurity removal and moisture control) in the 2G Ethanol plant
Understand different harvesting seasons (Ravi and Kharif) and daily requirement of Biomass based on plant capacity and seasonality

modules.module_title: Process of collection and storage of Biomass and Elements of Biomass supply chain model

pcs.pc_description: understand the infrastructure required at primary depot for storage of Biomass; Area, Firefighting system, weighing method, moisture control, avoiding auto methanation
understand about working of different farm equipment (implement) required in harvesting and baling operation: Harvester, Baler, Raker, Slasher, Tractor etc.

understand the modern method of logistics and special vehicle of primary transportation, primary storage and secondary transportation and storage at plant (Stacking methods, withdrawal method, protection from rain) and protection from hazard
understand Manual and mechanical operations involved in the Biomass supply chain model: Use of machineries for stacking, loading, Unloading, Weighing

Identified stakeholders involved in the supply chain model and Role of each stakeholder: Farmer, Farm Producing organization (FPO), Primary Agricultural credit society (PACS), equipment manufacturer and dealer, Aggregator, Transporter, Depot operator, Govt agency (State and Central) etc.

pcs.pc_description: Identify various cost elements of Biomass supply chain model
understand the fixed and variable components of the costing elements
Know quality measures to be adopted at field, primary depot and at plant. Use of moisture meter.

adhere to environmental regulations and implementing measures as defined by plant leadership to minimize the impact of the production process on the environment.
ensure the safety of personnel and facilities through proper training, hazard identification, and risk management as per sop.
